rows.note: This is the colloquial loanword and the all-purpose choice for the beauty treatment.

example.english: I’m going to the beauty salon for a facial today and will get my eyebrows shaped too.
example.traditional: 我今日去美容院做飛手，順便修下眉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 mei5 jung4 jyun2 zou6 fei1 sau2 seon6 bin2 sau1 haa5 mei4

rows.note: Use this more explicit term in salons, service descriptions, or formal contexts when you mean facial care specifically.

example.english: This salon’s facial treatment includes deep cleansing and moisturizing.
example.traditional: 呢間美容院嘅面部護理包括深層清潔同保濕。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 mei5 jung4 jyun2 ge3 min6 bou6 wu6 lei5 baau1 kut3 sam1 cang4 cing1 git3 tung4 bou2 sap1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for treatments or products intended to improve the appearance of the face.

example.english: After my facial, my face immediately looked much fresher.
example.traditional: 我做完美容，塊面即刻精神晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 mei5 jung4 faai3 min6 zik1 hak1 zing1 san4 saai3

rows.note: Use this for things concerning or affecting the face, especially before another noun.

example.english: The doctor said I have facial nerve inflammation and need to stay in hospital.
example.traditional: 醫生話我有面部神經發炎，要留院觀察。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 min6 bou6 san4 ging1 faat3 jim4 jiu3 lau4 jyun2 gun1 caat3

rows.note: Use this for a legal or other judgment that is valid or apparent on the surface before closer analysis.

example.english: This law has facial validity, but its practical application needs further study.
example.traditional: 呢條法例表面上有效，但實際執行仲要再研究。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 faat3 lai6 biu2 min6 soeng6 jau5 haau6 daan6 sat6 zai3 zap1 hang4 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 jin4 gau3
